summary: Service Operations Platform Phase 1 testing - Backend APIs 100% passing (31/31 tests), Frontend navigation to /service-ops broken due to window.location.href causing auth loss on page reload

ui_bugs.issue: Navigation to /service-ops uses window.location.href which causes full page reload, losing authentication state. User is redirected back to /master-admin after multiple 401 errors
ui_bugs.fix: Replace window.location.href = '/service-ops' with React Router's useNavigate() hook

integration_issues.issue: Cannot navigate to /service-ops from master-admin dashboard. The Service Ops button click triggers window.location.href which reloads the page and loses the auth token, causing 401 errors and redirect back to master-admin

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix Service Ops navigation in AdminSidebar.js - replace window.location.href with React Router navigate()
Change line 159 from: onClick={() => { window.location.href = '/service-ops'; }} to: onClick={() => { navigate('/service-ops'); }} and import useNavigate from react-router-dom
critical_code_review_comments: AdminSidebar.js line 159: Using window.location.href for SPA navigation is incorrect - causes full page reload and auth state loss
Same issue exists for Service Desk button at line 150: window.location.href = '/service-desk'

success_rate.frontend: 0% (cannot access /service-ops page due to navigation bug)

seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed cases created during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Service Ops APIs are fully functional. Frontend /service-ops page cannot be tested until navigation bug is fixed. The Service Ops button in AdminSidebar uses window.location.href which loses auth state on page reload. Rate limiting is aggressive - wait 3 minutes between login attempts.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: AdminSidebar.js uses window.location.href for navigation instead of React Router's navigate(). This causes a full page reload which loses the React app state including authentication context.
reproduction_steps: 4. Page reloads, /auth/me returns 401, user redirected back to /master-admin
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Replace window.location.href = '/service-ops' with navigate('/service-ops') using React Router's useNavigate hook
